messages:
ellie: hi folks  new hire here (day 2). quick checklist: who maintains the canonical service-owner list, who approves repo/GPU access, and who should I page if a model publish causes customer regressions? also any one-page cheat for escalation contacts?

mason: welcome ellie! :wave: canonical owners are in the handbook under service-ownership (link pinned in #product). we keep a trimmed one-pager for new hires0i'll DM it.

tara: repo/GPU access goes through eng-infra. easiest: use the access helper in #eng-infra. paste this snippet for a repo request:
```/access-request repo:redwood-inference/model-serving role:developer reason:"onboarding - commit access"```
for GPUs use the infra helper:```/infra-request resource:gpu-pool-2 quota:1 reason:"onboarding/testing"```
then tag @tara for review. paste the returned AR/IR into your ONBOARD ticket.

ellie: thanks! for the owner list, is there a tiny map i can keep pinned to avoid paging the wrong team?

leo: short cheat: runtime -> eng-runtime; serving infra -> eng-infra; api/gateway -> eng-platform; observability/alerts -> eng-sre; modelops -> eng-ml. for customer-impacting issues include support@redwood.com. i'll drop the one-pager in DMs.

ellie: scenario: a publish job finishes but routing still points to an old version and customers see stale completions  who do i page first?

leo: page eng-runtime first (they own model routing). if logs show infra problems (OOMs, evictions) bring eng-infra. if error rates spike or customer impact is visible include eng-sre + support@redwood.com. triage -> oncall -> incident if P1/P0.

mason: tiny tip: use staging for noisy tests. if you must test in prod, DM the oncall and annotate the run in the runbook to avoid waking people. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/alerting-guidelines

setup-bot: [auto] access request created: AR-12005 (repo:redwood-inference/model-serving) - requester: ellie - reviewer: tara - status: pending.

ellie: perfect  adding AR-12005 to my onboarding Jira. last Q: whom to cc for cross-team publish pipeline + infra failures?

leo: cc eng-runtime, eng-infra, eng-ml, and eng-sre. incident lead will coordinate; include support@redwood.com for customer comms.

ops-bot: [auto] reminder: complete SEC-101 security training within 5 business days to get full approvals.

ellie: awesome, thanks everyone! i'll follow up if anything stalls.
